events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Liverpool 0, Nottingham Forest 1. Dan Ndoye (Nottingham Forest) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Morgan Gibbs-White.
Igor Jesus (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Liverpool 0, Nottingham Forest 1.
Ola Aina (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Víctor Muñoz (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Liverpool 1, Nottingham Forest 1. Alexander Isak (Liverpool) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Cody Gakpo.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Liam Delap replaces Dan Ndoye.
Alisson Becker (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Liverpool 1, Nottingham Forest 2. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham Forest) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Liverpool. Rio Ngumoha replaces Cody Gakpo.
Substitution, Liverpool. Kostas Tsimikas replaces Milos Kerkez.
Substitution, Liverpool. Ryan Gravenberch replaces Jeremie Frimpong.
Substitution, Liverpool. Ronald Araujo replaces Jérémy Jacquet.

Ronald Araujo (Liverpool) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Liverpool 2, Nottingham Forest 2. Víctor Muñoz (Liverpool) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Florian Wirtz.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Luca Netz replaces Ola Aina.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Callum Hudson-Odoi replaces James McAtee.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Nicolás Domínguez replaces Igor Jesus.
Second Half ends, Liverpool 2, Nottingham Forest 2.
